label: The unchanged causal copying mechanism admits an attitude-free control (inference)
rule: Retain the same causes and channel while interpreting all represented attitudes and plans as empty
meaning: Applies the same exact-value production guarantee without attributing cognition or assertion to the source. The empty mental relations are explicitly disclosed and not mistaken for empty causation; the positive cognitive control restores them. Necessity is stipulated on a universal frame and is not what proves record truth. Comparison beyond these functional conditions remains a philosophical application question.
